llm.summary: This is a single non-executable writing-style skill that tells the agent to answer more concisely and does not request sensitive access.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is response compression, and the artifact only provides communication guidance for removing filler, preserving safety warnings, and keeping useful technical context.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill can broadly affect answer style when active, but its scope is disclosed and includes exceptions for setup instructions, education, uncertainty, and safety-critical details.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only one SKILL.md markdown file; it has no scripts, binaries, hooks, or install-time execution.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No artifact instruction asks to read files, access credentials, use the network, run commands, index local data, or mutate user systems.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background worker, privilege escalation, session reuse, or local profile access is present in the packaged skill.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you want the agent to produce shorter, more direct responses. Be aware it may reduce warmth or detail, so disable it for teaching, onboarding, or tasks where expanded explanations are valuable.
